shared_elements: T-shaped monolithic pillar with broad head and narrower shaft
animal carved in relief on the pillar shaft
animal oriented vertically along the shaft
otherwise blank ground around the figures
justification: Both depict a T-headed pillar bearing carved animals, and in each case a quadruped in profile is placed on the shaft, which is a reasonably specific correspondence. But A is crowded with multiple registers — a fringed horizontal band, rows of quadrupeds, small human-like figures and large long-necked birds — rendered in flat, schematic low relief, whereas B shows a single rounded, almost sculptural animal descending head-first on an otherwise unornamented surface.
